2.152.16
ChartLegend.InterlacedRowsColor
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartLegend.InterlacedRowsColor element specifies the background color to use for
interlaced rows in a ChartLegend. The ChartLegend.InterlacedRowsColor element is optional. The
value of this element MUST be an RdlColor or an expression that evaluates to an RdlColor. If the
ChartLegend.InterlacedRowsColor element is not present, the background color of the ChartArea
is used, as specified in the ChartArea.Style element.
Following is the parent element of the ChartLegend.InterlacedRowsColor element.
Parent elements
ChartLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartLegend.InterlacedRowsColor element.
 <xsd:element name="InterlacedRowsColor" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
